Case decomposition transfers bidirectionally between Number Theory, Counting/Probability, and Precalculus (25%). Modular arithmetic chains transfer from Number Theory to Counting/Probability for combinatorial congruence problems. Algebraic bound setup from Number Theory (51% Level 5) transfers to Precalculus optimization. Geometry's auxiliary construction technique remains domain-unique due to spatial reasoning requirements.
